editionLabel: Czech Games Edition English base game · 2025 revision
firstPlayerRule: The key card determines the starting team: its edge indicators show that team’s color. That team’s spymaster gives the first clue.
officialTieBreak: Not applicable: the key card identifies the starting team.
clarifications: Spymasters draw a random key card during setup. The starting team has one additional word to find.
The first move belongs to a team; do not replace the key card’s assignment with a random individual player.
This is the base game, not Codenames: Duet or Pictures.

sources.title: Codenames — English rulebook EN 30
sources.location: Setup and key on page 2; How to Play on page 4; credits on page 7

internalEvidence: Located through the publisher’s Codenames rules-download widget. Visually checked setup page 2 and read play instructions and 2015–2025 credits. The key determines the team; the spymaster starts its turn.
uncertainty: The example key is not a rule that a particular color always starts.
